refinement_comparison.notes: Native aligned samples, no interpolation, time shifts or curve fitting. Density RMS is at the numerical grid scale; local moments use the recorded physical Gaussian lengths. Fingerprint equality requires the same dtype/runtime. One repeat is not an uncertainty estimate; field saturation and small conservation defects do not establish convergence. Null relative errors have zero reference norm. joint_validation.scope: Raw diagnostic reduction after strict loading-byte rejection

independent_audit.protocol: S5 cell integral of raw centered B4, nonnegative Cox–de Boor recurrence plus three-node Gauss quadrature split at B4 knots. Serial particle chunks and math.fsum reduction; x_integer wraps x_native −dt·v/2. No production shape functions.
independent_audit.limitation: Native all-step work and continuity maxima retained, not independently reconstructed from missing particle/current histories. Single new-count seed-zero finite-N loading, not ensemble uncertainty, temporal order, late Hook reproduction or evidence of irreversible heating. Elapsed timing is one execution, not a controlled throughput benchmark.

joint_validation.notes: Single new-count Gaussian realization; no ensemble, order or convergence claim. All gates use raw fixed windows. Accounting envelopes are not loading/spatial/temporal uncertainty. Original nominal-clock and Gauss failures stay visible; no state projection or phase alignment.
